title: Kerberos DES and RC4 Weak Encryption Types are Permitted
description: DES and RC4 encryption types in Kerberos are cryptographically vulnerable and should be disallowed in favor of AES-128 and AES-256.
expected: SupportedEncryptionTypes does not allow DES or RC4 (Bitmask excludes 0x1, 0x2, 0x4)
impact: Kerberoasting and ticket-forgery attacks (Silver/Golden Ticket) can crack service ticket hashes significantly faster using RC4.

compliance_mappings.title: Network Security: Configure encryption types allowed for Kerberos
